```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

if (!exists("project_folder")) {
  project_folder <- getwd()
  pipeline_folder <- getwd()
  features_file <- "config/features.yaml"
  sample_file <- "config/samples.tsv"
}

source(file.path(pipeline_folder, "workflow", "scripts", "R", "report_helpers.R"))

samples <- readr::read_tsv(file.path(project_folder, sample_file), show_col_types = FALSE)
```

## Overview

This report covers the **reads** module: FastQC/MultiQC quality control of every raw
sequencing lane, before any trimming or contamination removal.

```{r sample-sheet}
preview_table(samples, n = nrow(samples), caption = "Sample sheet")
```

`r nrow(samples)` raw lanes across `r length(unique(samples$sample_id))` samples were processed.

## Raw read FastQC summary

```{r raw-fastqc, results='asis'}
rows <- purrr::pmap(samples, function(sample_id, library_id, ...) {
  zip_path <- file.path(project_folder, "QC", "RAW", sprintf("%s.%s_fastqc.zip", sample_id, library_id))
  df <- parse_fastqc_zip(zip_path)
  if (nrow(df) == 0) return(NULL)
  tibble::tibble(
    sample_id = sample_id, library_id = library_id,
    total_sequences = df[["Total Sequences"]],
    pct_gc = df[["%GC"]],
    sequence_length = df[["Sequence length"]]
  )
})
fastqc_summary <- dplyr::bind_rows(rows)
preview_table(fastqc_summary, n = nrow(fastqc_summary), caption = "Raw FastQC basic statistics per lane")
```

## Runtime and resource usage

```{r runtime}
bench <- discover_benchmarks(project_folder, "reads")
runtime_table(bench, caption = "reads module: runtime and peak memory per rule")
resource_allocation_table(bench, "reads", project_folder,
                           caption = "reads module: allocated vs. actual resource usage")
```

```{r runtime-plot, fig.width=7, fig.height=3}
runtime_plot(bench, title = "reads module: total runtime per rule")
```
